title: Why some QR codes stop working after a free trial
description: Understand static codes, dynamic redirects, and trial expiry. Check a code before printing and learn what you can do if an existing code stops working.

title: QR code stopped working? How to find the cause and fix it
description: Scan it and look at what opens. Find out if the print, your website, or the QR company's redirect failed, and which fixes need a reprint.
